title: MySQL integrated: DROP COLUMN is applied at the source but not at the destination

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: MySQL 8.4.13, integrated CDC, one run

symptom: After DROP COLUMN (SHOW COLUMNS confirmed it at the source), the destination kept the column through two later updates, and new rows had NULL in it. No schema-change event for the drop appeared.
effect: The destination has a column the source no longer has, and the update reports no error.
fix: Not tested: check the destination after each drop, and full refresh the table if it must match the source.
notes: Two updates after the drop, one run.
